items.html: *Know this rule: everything we speak of, that times are needed for the Gadlut of ZA — all this was at the time of the first Emanation (Atzilut). But from there onward, after ZA was emanated at the time of Atzilut and was corrected, behold, even though every single day it returns to receive new Mochin as at first, as stated in other discourses whose place is not here, it does not need to wait any time, for in one moment it is done, and not in these long times. And keep this rule with you.
